name: Literally FNF!
desc:
The most.. FNF-like roblox experience

Version 1.0c②: (NOT v2.0, the v2.0 update will come out in the future)
   Release :- August 1st 2024
   Change Log :- https://devforum.roblox.com/t/3097159

Version 1.0c2:
   Release :- FOOLS DAY 2024
   Change Log :- https://devforum.roblox.com/t/2899396

Version 1.0c:
   Release :- May 10th 2023
   Change Log :- https://devforum.roblox.com/t/2332985

This experience is completely based off of FNF.

Default Keybinds:
      • Console - YXAB or D-Pad
      • PC - WASD or Arrow Keys

The creators of FNF:
      • ninjamuffin99 for Programming and Charting
      • PhantomArcade for Art & Animation
      • evilsk8r for Art
      • KawaiSprite for composing Music/Sounds

Additional credits are provided inside the experience itself. Credits are always present onscreen.

And go play the real FNF and support the original creators too if you can, want to, and if you are 13+ lol.
